parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: _read_all swallows OSError/ValueError/KeyError and returns an empty dict, so a failed or corrupt read is treated as an empty store, and the subsequent read-modify-write in save/delete writes back that empty dict, erasing all other sessions. Both also note reads then see sessions as missing. Same root cause, same location.
